_meta.purpose: Deterministic surface-form -> canonical-node-id maps for runtime normalization (Validator/Retriever/Explainer). Ambiguous or context-dependent surfaces are intentionally excluded and live only in merged_kg_alias_index.json.
_meta.policy: One surface form may appear in at most one map and must map to exactly one canonical node id. Conflicts are demoted to _review_required and to merged_kg_alias_index.json. Targets MUST exist in merged_kg_nodes.jsonl.

_normalization_rules.punctuation: Strip ASCII/full-width whitespace; keep zh-TW characters as-is. Treat 'X形' and 'X型' as equivalent (both map to T_term_271). Treat full-width parentheses as equivalent to half-width.
_normalization_rules.case: English aliases are case-insensitive at lookup time.
_normalization_rules.ambiguous: If a surface form is missing here, try merged_kg_alias_index.json. If multiple candidates exist there, the runtime MUST call the disambiguation prompt (KG_BUILD_SPEC §7 Step 2). Never silently pick.
_normalization_rules.priority: Lookup order: severity_map > action_map > element_map > pattern_map > failure_mode_map > cause_map > code_map > auxiliary_map. Stop at first hit.
